salary_details.details: In addition to the remuneration, a consolidated amount of Rs. 12,000/- per year is paid towards insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc. Gratuity is admissible as per the applicable provisions of the BEL Employees' Gratuity Scheme. Selected candidates must obtain a Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per annum at the time of joining.

selection_process: The selection process comprises a Written Test followed by an Interview.

Written Test: Carries 85% weightage. The venue will be at Bengaluru and Delhi. Interview: Carries 15% weightage. Candidates who pass the written test are called for interview in a 1:5 ratio in order of merit in each category. Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks are 35% for General
and PwBD candidates in both written test and interview separately.
how_to_apply: Visit the official BEL website at https://bel-india.in and click on the relevant advertisement link.
Make the application fee payment via SBI Collect and note down the SBI Collect Reference Number.
Register online using the link provided on the official website and fill in all necessary fields accurately.
Upload required documents along with the fee receipt/challan.
Submit the application form and save the generated PDF sent to your registered email ID.
Take a printout of the filled application form to carry to the selection center along with 2 recent passport-size color photographs and relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants whose discipline/specialisation mentioned in their Degree Certificates do not tally with the prescribed discipline/specialisation will not be considered. Candidates must possess a post-qualification industrial experience of at least 2 years as on 01.10.2026. Teaching, academic, or research work, experience in banking and financial institutions, non-profit organisations, and internship placements forming part of an academic curriculum are not considered as relevant industrial experience.

rows.qualification_required: Pass Class in BE/ B. Tech in Computer Science/Electronics & Communication from an AICTE/UGC approved college/Institute or recognized University.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.10.2026 for General and EWS candidates.

rows.relaxation: 10 Years (in addition to applicable category relaxation)

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Salary 2026
content_sections.text: In addition to the remuneration, a consolidated amount of Rs. 12,000/- per year is paid towards insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc. Gratuity is admissible as per the applicable provisions of the BEL Employees' Gratuity Scheme. Selected candidates must obtain a Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per annum at the time of joining.

rows.pay_details: Rs. 50,000/- per month consolidated for the 1st Year, with an annual increase of Rs. 5,000/- for every year of contract extension.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online via SBI Collect under PSU - Public Sector Undertaking selecting Bharat Electronics Limited and payment category "Project Engineer-I Post for NWCS". No fee is accepted via cheque, DD, or cash.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Written Test followed by an Interview. Written Test: Carries 85% weightage. The venue will be at Bengaluru and Delhi. Interview: Carries 15% weightage. Candidates who pass the written test are called for interview in a 1:5 ratio in order of merit in each category. Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks are 35% for General, OBC, and EWS candidates, and 30% for SC, ST, and PwBD candidates in both written test and interview separately.
